newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha slips, end user demand seen satisfied.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha slips, end user demand seen satisfied.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices edged lower in quiet physical trading with end user demand seen fulfilled until at least the middle of the month, traders said on Wednesday.
Talk continued of cargoes being loaded together in the Med to be sent to NWE to optimize freight rates, but it was unclear if they were on offer or already contracted to end users.
Mira Oil and BASF fixed two clean tankers for about 60,000 tonnes each out of Skikda for northwest Europe to be loaded in Nov 1-10, tanker sources said.
